tiers.established: Acts on breast-cancer practice today: subtyping, prognosis, or a drug target.
tiers.investigational: Real breast-cancer literature, but no established clinical action.
tiers.not_established: No curated breast-cancer role in this reference. Absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.

caveat: A curated list, not a computed result. It says what is established in the literature, never that a feature is or is not important in this cohort.
